scope: Explicit expiry of one authenticated offsite recovery bundle and all identical historical versions; not complete account erasure
controlled_cases: two-page inventory; old/current versions and delete markers
all contents verified before any delete
strict versionId query and final empty inventory
lost DELETE response followed by idempotent retry
late version and final-list failure do not prove completion
foreign keys, corrupt bytes, missing truncation, repeated pagination and redirects rejected
4 GiB verification traffic limit checked before reads
HMAC authenticated 14-day expiry; local receipt retained
limitations: Controlled signed HTTP transport, not real COS permissions or deletion
Orphan uploads without local receipts require separate reconciliation
No account-specific erasure or independent deletion-ledger retirement
